title: The Rehearsal Dinner
cn: 第 12 集 · 彩排晚宴
novel:
Barney wanted his [[rehearsal|rehearsal]] dinner to be held at a laser tag [[arena|arena]]. Everyone thought this was a [[ridiculous|ridiculous]] idea for a formal wedding event. Robin was especially [[frustrated|frustrate]] because she had planned a [[fancy|fancy]] dinner at a nice restaurant.

Barney [[insisted|insist]] on the laser tag idea and refused to [[compromise|compromise]]. He said it would be the most memorable rehearsal dinner ever. Robin [[argued|argue]] that their guests deserved a proper meal, not laser tag games.

Meanwhile, Ted had [[failed|fail]] to come through on a [[promise|promise]] he made to Lily. He had agreed to pick up a special [[gift|gift]] for Marshall, but he forgot. Lily was [[disappointed|disappoint]] and felt that Ted was being [[careless|careless]].

Ted tried to [[fix|fix]] the situation by finding a replacement gift at the last minute. He searched through every shop near the hotel but could not find anything [[suitable|suitable]]. He felt [[guilty|guilty]] for letting Lily down.

At the rehearsal dinner, Barney [[surprised|surprise]] everyone. He had actually arranged a [[beautiful|beautiful]] dinner on the ice at a skating rink. The laser tag idea had been a trick to lower expectations. Robin was [[touched|touch]] by the surprise.

The dinner was a great success. Everyone enjoyed the food and the unique setting. Ted found a suitable gift just in time, and Lily [[forgave|forgive]] him for his mistake.

Barney gave a speech that made everyone laugh and cry. He thanked his friends for standing by him through good times and bad. The evening ended with a group hug, and Robin told Barney it was the best surprise of her life.

arena.en: The concert was held in a big arena.

fancy.en: They went to a fancy restaurant.

insist.en: He insisted on paying the bill.

fail.en: He failed to keep his promise.

gift.en: He bought a gift for his mother.

suitable.en: The dress was suitable for the occasion.

surprise.en: He surprised his wife with flowers.
